## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Refactor (`refactor:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Build system (`build:`)
- [ ] CI (`ci:`)
- [ ] Tests (`test:`)
- [ ] Maintenance (`chore:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The project configures and builds with
      `-DENABLE_CPPPOET_TEST=ON -DENABLE_CPPPOET_EXAMPLE=ON`.
- [ ] `ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure` passes locally.
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests where practical.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`type: subject`, English, no
      scope).
- [ ] Sources are formatted with the pinned `clang-format` (18.1.8).
